data.gender_notes: Hasnaat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A bestowal or gift from Allah, a manifestation of divine grace. The name Hasnaat carries the meaning “Gift, Grace” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hasnaat usually hope their child will grow to embody gift, grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sign of Allah's blessings and mercy
data.etymology: Hasnaat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gift, Grace.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hasnaat total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
